title: Breaking bonds, building mistrust: how coups reshape social capital in Africa
title_zh: 打破纽带，滋生不信任：政变如何重塑非洲的社会资本
title_primary: 打破纽带，滋生不信任：政变如何重塑非洲的社会资本
title_secondary: Breaking bonds, building mistrust: how coups reshape social capital in Africa
authors: Linfeng Wang, Michael Appiah-Kubi, Joseph Amoah, Philip Akrofi Atitianti, Jeneshia Jarrett
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Military coups have become an increasingly common yet understudied form of institutional shock across Africa, with consequences for social capital that remain poorly understood relative to their economic and political costs. This paper provides the first comprehensive causal analysis of how successful coups affect both horizontal (interpersonal) and vertical (institutional) trust. Using Afrobarometer data (2005–2015) from 24 African countries, we show that successful coups reduce interpersonal trust by 3.3 percentage points and institutional trust by 6.7 percentage points, after controlling for regional coup dynamics. These effects are specific to successful seizures of power: failed coup attempts have no significant effect on interpersonal trust and produce only a short-lived boost in institutional trust that quickly reverses. Temporal dynamics reveal a critical asymmetry: interpersonal trust recovers gradually over 15–20 years, whereas institutional trust follows a boom-bust cycle before entering a monotonic decline, driven primarily by deteriorating government performance evaluations rather than by economic disruption. Young adults and members of ethnic majority groups bear disproportionately severe institutional trust deficits, and the interethnic trust response is itself heterogeneous, with majority group members showing a temporary upward adjustment while minority group members show a much smaller gain. These findings challenge narratives that portray coups as corrective mechanisms, calling instead for sustained, targeted reconstruction that addresses both dimensions of social capital simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 军事政变已成为非洲日益普遍但研究不足的制度冲击形式，其对社会资本的影响相较于经济和政治成本而言仍鲜有深入理解。本文首次对成功政变如何影响横向（人际）信任与纵向（制度）信任进行了全面的因果分析。利用来自24个非洲国家的“非洲晴雨表”数据（2005-2015年），在控制区域政变动态后，我们发现成功政变使人际信任降低3.3个百分点，制度信任降低6.7个百分点。这些效应仅针对成功的权力夺取：失败的政变尝试对人际信任无显著影响，仅对制度信任产生短暂提升，且该提升迅速逆转。时间动态揭示了一个关键的不对称性：人际信任在15至20年间逐步恢复，而制度信任则经历“繁荣-衰退”周期后进入单调下降，其主要驱动因素是政府绩效评价的恶化，而非经济破坏。年轻成年人和多数族群成员承受着尤为严重的制度信任赤字，且族群间信任反应本身具有异质性，多数族群成员表现出暂时的向上调整，而少数族群成员的增益则小得多。这些发现挑战了将政变视为纠偏机制的说法，转而呼吁进行持续且有针对性的重建，同时解决社会资本的两个维度。

title: Weather and retail investor behaviour: directional trading decisions or risk-taking?
title_zh: 天气与散户投资者行为：方向性交易决策还是风险承担？
title_primary: 天气与散户投资者行为：方向性交易决策还是风险承担？
title_secondary: Weather and retail investor behaviour: directional trading decisions or risk-taking?
authors: Shaosong Wang, Ming-Chien Sung, Peter Fraser-Mackenzie, Johnnie Johnson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article re-examines the relationship between weather and investor behaviour. Much of the earlier literature treats weather mainly as a source of sentiment, but the evidence remains mixed and the mechanism remains unclear. We argue that weather may be more closely related to investors’ willingness to trade and take risks than to their directional beliefs. Using more than 300,000 trades placed by over 14,000 UK retail spread traders, matched with hourly local weather conditions, we test whether weather is associated with buy-sell direction or with several margins of trading activity and risk-taking. We find little evidence of a consistent effect on the propensity to buy rather than sell. By contrast, weather is more clearly related to trading participation, trading frequency, and investment size.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了天气与投资者行为之间的关系。早期文献多将天气主要视为情绪来源，但证据尚不一致，机制亦不明确。我们认为，天气可能与投资者的交易意愿及风险承担更为紧密相关，而非其方向性信念。利用超过14,000名英国零售点差交易者进行的逾300,000笔交易，并结合每小时当地天气状况，我们检验了天气是否与买卖方向或交易活动及风险承担的多个维度相关。我们发现，天气对买入而非卖出倾向的影响缺乏一致性证据。相比之下，天气与交易参与度、交易频率及投资规模的关系更为显著。

title: Can Private Markets Fill the Gap? Graduate Student Lending After the Elimination of GradPLUS
title_zh: 私人市场能否填补空白？GradPLUS取消后的研究生贷款
title_primary: 私人市场能否填补空白？GradPLUS取消后的研究生贷款
title_secondary: Can Private Markets Fill the Gap? Graduate Student Lending After the Elimination of GradPLUS
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA, P.L. 119-21) eliminates the federal GradPLUS loan program for new borrowers effective July 1, 2026, replacing nearly two decades of uncapped federal graduate lending with annual limits of $20,500 ($50,000 for eleven professional fields) and new aggregate caps. The resulting financing gap — approximately $8 billion annually across roughly 370,000 affected borrowers — raises the question of whether and how private capital will substitute for displaced federal lending. This paper analyzes the economics of that transition. Before GradPLUS, private lenders filled the gap between federal Stafford limits and graduate program costs, with nonfederal graduate originations reaching $5.3 billion (constant 2024 dollars) by 2005–06. After GradPLUS extended federal borrowing to the full cost of attendance in 2006, private lending collapsed — falling more than 70 percent within a few years and never recovering. The federal program provided not only credit but, through income-driven repayment and Public Service Loan Forgiveness, insurance against earnings risk that no private product could replicate. The same features that crowded out private lending generated compounding distortions: borrowing untethered to repayment capacity, upward pressure on tuition, and a reversal from projected federal surpluses to losses exceeding thirty cents per GradPLUS dollar lent. Linking institution-by-field federal borrowing data to institution-by-field earnings outcomes, I examine the relationship between historical borrowing above the new OBBBA caps and post-completion earnings across programs. I find substantial variation in the extent to which different degree programs would likely support above-cap borrowing from private lenders or other sources. In fields such as law and MBA, earnings rise steeply with borrowing exposure, providing a basis for program-level risk pricing; in fields such as social work, counseling psychology, and physical therapy, the earnings-to-borrowing gradient is essentially flat. I also examine features of the private capital market and institutional responses shaping the transition — including capital constraints on scaling private lending, legal barriers to using program-level outcomes data in underwriting, and the emerging role of institutions as intermediaries between lenders and students.
abstract_zh: 《一项重大美丽法案》（OBBBA，公法119-21）自2026年7月1日起取消联邦GradPLUS贷款计划对新借款人的资格，以每年20,500美元（十一个专业领域为50,000美元）的年度限额和新的总限额取代了近二十年无上限的联邦研究生贷款。由此产生的融资缺口——每年约80亿美元，涉及约37万名受影响借款人——引发了私人资本是否以及如何替代被取代的联邦贷款的问题。本文分析了这一转变的经济学逻辑。在GradPLUS计划之前，私人贷款机构填补了联邦斯塔福德贷款限额与研究生项目成本之间的缺口，非联邦研究生贷款发放额在2005-06年度达到53亿美元（按2024年不变美元计算）。2006年GradPLUS将联邦借款扩展至全部就读成本后，私人贷款急剧萎缩——几年内下降超过70%，且从未恢复。联邦计划不仅提供信贷，还通过收入驱动还款和公共服务贷款豁免提供了收入风险保险，这是任何私人产品都无法复制的。正是这些挤出私人贷款的特征产生了叠加的扭曲效应：借款与还款能力脱钩、对学费形成上行压力，以及联邦盈余预期逆转至每发放一美元GradPLUS贷款损失超过三十美分的局面。通过将按院校-专业划分的联邦借款数据与按院校-专业划分的收入结果相匹配，我考察了超出新OBBBA上限的历史借款与各项目毕业后期收入之间的关系。我发现不同学位项目在多大程度上可能支持从私人贷款机构或其他来源进行超上限借款方面存在显著差异。在法律和MBA等领域，收入随借款敞口急剧上升，为项目层面风险定价提供了基础；而在社会工作、咨询心理学和物理治疗等领域，收入与借款之间的梯度基本持平。我还考察了塑造这一转型的私人资本市场特征和机构应对措施——包括私人贷款规模扩张的资本约束、在承保中使用项目层面结果数据的法律障碍，以及机构作为贷款人与学生之间中介的新兴角色。

title: Market Size, Trading Frictions, and Selling Pressure in Experimental Over-The-Counter Asset Markets
title_zh: 市场规模、交易摩擦与场外资产市场实验中的抛售压力
title_primary: 市场规模、交易摩擦与场外资产市场实验中的抛售压力
title_secondary: Market Size, Trading Frictions, and Selling Pressure in Experimental Over-The-Counter Asset Markets
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates market outcomes and trading behavior in experimental over-the-counter (OTC) asset markets. By reducing market size from 9 to 4 participants, the experiment induces changes in trading frictions and selling pressure that produce distinct effects at both the market and individual levels. The results show the emergence of positive price bubbles in both treatments, even though the fundamental value remains constant. The findings further demonstrate that the lower traded prices and narrower bid–ask spreads observed in smaller OTC markets are largely attributable to the decrease in ask prices. This pattern can be interpreted as a consequence of the increased difficulty sellers face in executing trades within a smaller OTC market, where fewer potential buyers heighten overall trading frictions and amplify selling pressure. Consequently, sellers lower their ask prices to complete transactions.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了实验性场外交易（OTC）资产市场中的市场结果与交易行为。通过将市场规模从9名参与者缩减至4名，实验引发了交易摩擦与卖出压力的变化，这些变化在市场和个体层面均产生了不同效应。结果显示，尽管基础价值保持不变，两种处理方式下均出现了正向价格泡沫。进一步研究发现，较小OTC市场中观察到的较低成交价格和更窄的买卖价差，主要归因于要价（ask prices）的下降。这一模式可解释为，在较小的OTC市场中，卖方执行交易面临更大难度，潜在买家数量减少加剧了整体交易摩擦并放大了卖出压力，因此，卖方降低要价以促成交易完成。

title: Platform Fulfilment and Seller Reputation: Evidence From Amazon's Marketplace
title_zh: 平台履约与卖家声誉：来自亚马逊市场的证据
title_primary: 平台履约与卖家声誉：来自亚马逊市场的证据
title_secondary: Platform Fulfilment and Seller Reputation: Evidence From Amazon's Marketplace
authors: Chinonso E. Etumnu, Kenneth A. Foster
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In 2006, Amazon launched the Fulfilment by Amazon (FBA) program, providing support to third‐party sellers for a fee. While the program has the potential to enhance sellers' reputations, evidence regarding its effectiveness is limited. This study estimates the association between FBA usage and seller reputation, measured by the average star rating a seller receives. Using fixed effects and staggered difference‐in‐differences estimation approaches as well as 26 weeks of panel data from Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States, three key findings emerge. First, using FBA is significantly and positively associated with a seller's reputation, leading to higher average ratings in the short term than in the long term. This improvement is mainly due to FBA's competitive advantages, such as eligibility for Amazon Prime, standardised fulfilment quality and excellent customer service. Second, although the correlation between FBA and reputation is positive in every country, we find cross‐country heterogeneity in effect sizes and significance levels, with the largest effects in Canada. Third, we show that large sellers have the best reputation, and all sellers benefit from the FBA program. However, medium‐sized sellers benefit the most from the program. This trend can be attributed to how the benefits of the FBA program accrue optimally to sellers based on their operational scale. These results suggest that the FBA program is indeed effective in enhancing seller reputation, with implications for third‐party sellers, Amazon and regulators.
abstract_zh: 2006年年，亚马逊推出了亚马逊物流（FBA）计划，为第三方卖家提供有偿支持服务。尽管该计划有潜力提升卖家的声誉，但关于其有效性的证据仍然有限。本研究通过卖家获得的平均星级评分来衡量声誉，估计了使用FBA与卖家声誉之间的关联。利用固定效应和交错双重差分估计方法，以及来自加拿大、英国和美国的26周面板数据，我们得出了三个关键发现。第一，使用FBA与卖家声誉显著正相关，短期内平均评分提升幅度大于长期。这一改善主要归因于FBA的竞争优势，如符合亚马逊Prime资格、标准化的物流质量和卓越的客户服务。第二，尽管FBA与声誉之间的正相关在每个国家都存在，但我们发现效应大小和显著性水平存在跨国异质性，其中加拿大的效应最大。第三，我们表明大型卖家拥有最佳声誉，且所有卖家均从FBA计划中受益。然而，中型卖家从该计划中获益最多。这一趋势可归因于FBA计划的收益如何根据卖家的运营规模最优地累积。这些结果表明，FBA计划确实能有效提升卖家声誉，对第三方卖家、亚马逊及监管机构均具有启示意义。

title: Labor Market Trends and the Changing Value of Time
title_zh: 劳动力市场趋势与时间价值的变迁
title_primary: 劳动力市场趋势与时间价值的变迁
title_secondary: Labor Market Trends and the Changing Value of Time
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2020-02-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a model with incomplete asset markets and household heterogeneity in market and home technologies and preferences to account for these labor market trends and assess their welfare consequences. Using micro data on expenditures and time use, we identify the sources of heterogeneity across households, document how these sources have changed over time, and perform counterfactual analyses. Given the observed increase in leisure expenditures relative to leisure time and the complementarity of these inputs in leisure technology, we infer a significant increase in the average productivity of time spent on leisure. The increasing productivity of leisure time generates significant welfare gains for the average household and moderates negative welfare effects from the rising dispersion of expenditures and time allocation across households.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全资产市场以及家庭在市场、家庭技术和偏好方面异质性的模型，以解释这些劳动力市场趋势并评估其福利后果。利用支出和时间使用的微观数据，我们识别了家庭间异质性的来源，记录了这些来源随时间的变化，并进行了反事实分析。鉴于休闲支出相对于休闲时间的增加，以及这些投入在休闲技术中的互补性，我们推断出休闲时间平均生产率显著提升。休闲时间生产率的提高为平均家庭带来了显著的福利收益，并缓和了因支出和家庭间时间分配离散度上升而产生的负面福利效应。

title: A Strategic Compass for Navigating Senegal's Debt Crisis
title_zh: 塞内加尔债务危机导航的战略指南针
title_primary: 塞内加尔债务危机导航的战略指南针
title_secondary: A Strategic Compass for Navigating Senegal's Debt Crisis
authors: Abdoulaye Ndiaye, Martin Kessler, Luiz de Mello, Joao Tovar Jalles, Álvaro Pina 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper reviews the constraints and difficult choices the government faces in managing the debt crisis. We explore two possible paths. In the first approach, the government seeks to avoid restructuring at all costs. For debt to remain sustainable, it needs to maintain extremely tight fiscal policy for an extended period and refinance existing debt at very low interest rates. We provide quantification of both efforts, and show that such a strategy could work, albeit under very narrow – and to some extent – unlikely, assumptions: the level of consolidation expected would probably deteriorate economic growth and be counterproductive, or politically unsustainable. Moreover, the level of bilateral or multilateral support would need to be substantial: only by securing partners willing to take risks at low interest rates could Senegal refinance its debt due in 2026 and 2027. It would also require large net financing from regional banks, thus transferring risks to the monetary union. In the second approach, the government aims to negotiate with its bilateral and private external creditors to restructure its debt under an IMF program. We argue that this could be achieved through a less radical fiscal adjustment than in the previous scenario, where restructuring is avoided. It would seek to avoid implicating regional lenders, arguing that doing so would worsen the country's prospects and even those of its external creditors. Such a strategy would also involve mobilizing the international community through new multilateral concessional loans, along with high-level political commitments from its main bilateral creditors, France and China, to achieve fast and comprehensive debt relief, comparable to that achieved by private creditors. It also requires strengthening fiscal and prudential oversight within the zone. We argue that while there are considerable pressures to repay, the economic literature teaches us that the costs of delaying a restructuring are higher.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了政府在管理债务危机中所面临的约束与艰难抉择。我们探讨了两条可能的路径。第一种路径中，政府力求不惜一切代价避免债务重组。为使债务保持可持续性，政府需在较长时期内维持极度紧缩的财政政策，并以极低的利率对现有债务进行再融资。我们对这两种努力进行了量化分析，并表明该策略虽有可能奏效，但前提假设极为狭窄——在某种程度上甚至不太可能成立：预期的财政整顿力度可能会恶化经济增长，产生反效果，或在政治上难以维系。此外，双边或多边支持的水平需相当可观：唯有获得愿意以低利率承担风险的合作伙伴，塞内加尔才能为其2026年和2027年到期的债务进行再融资。这还需从区域银行获得大规模净融资，从而将风险转移至货币联盟。第二种路径中，政府旨在与国际货币基金组织（IMF）项目框架下，与其双边及私人外部债权人进行谈判，以重组其债务。我们认为，相较于前一种避免重组的方案，此路径可通过力度较小的财政调整来实现。该策略力求避免牵涉区域贷款机构，并主张这样做将恶化国家前景，甚至损害其外部债权人的利益。这一策略还将涉及通过新的多边优惠贷款动员国际社会，并借助其主要双边债权人法国和中国的高层政治承诺，以实现快速而全面的债务减免，其程度可与私人债权人达成的减免相媲美。同时，还需加强区域内财政与审慎监管。我们认为，尽管存在相当大的偿还压力，但经济文献告诉我们，拖延重组的代价更高。

title: Stochastic modeling of labor supply and discouraged worker behavior
title_zh: 劳动力供给与受挫工人行为的随机建模
title_primary: 劳动力供给与受挫工人行为的随机建模
title_secondary: Stochastic modeling of labor supply and discouraged worker behavior
authors: John K. Dagsvik, Tom Kornstad, Terje Skjerpen
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Discouraged workers are those who have given up searching for work because of the (perceived) low chances of obtaining it. In this paper we develop a stochastic structural econometric framework for analyzing discouraged worker behavior based on the theory of job search and the notion of probabilistic rationality and risky choice. Subsequently, we conduct an empirical analysis of immigrant women from non-Western countries and women born in Norway, using microdata on labor force participation and unemployment. We find that the discouraged worker effect is particularly high among immigrant women with low wage rates and many children.
abstract_zh: 沮丧劳动者是指那些因（感知到的）获得工作机会渺茫而放弃求职的人群。本文基于工作搜寻理论以及概率理性与风险选择的概念，构建了一个随机结构计量经济学框架，用以分析沮丧劳动者行为。随后，我们利用劳动力参与和失业的微观数据，对来自非西方国家的移民女性及挪威本土出生的女性进行了实证分析。研究发现，沮丧劳动者效应在工资率低且子女众多的移民女性群体中尤为显著。

title: The impact of high land use costs and mining royalties on mining operating costs in Turkey
title_zh: 高土地使用成本与采矿权使用费对土耳其矿业运营成本的影响
title_primary: 高土地使用成本与采矿权使用费对土耳其矿业运营成本的影响
title_secondary: The impact of high land use costs and mining royalties on mining operating costs in Turkey
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In Turkey, mining companies are required to pay various types of forest fees to the forestry administration, as well as environmental compliance fees, state rights, and operating license fees to the relevant mining and environmental authorities. Rehabilitation and waste management costs, in contrast, are not fees calculated and collected directly by public authorities; rather, they are expenditures incurred by mining companies to fulfill their regulatory obligations. In recent years, legislative changes in Turkey concerning the calculation methods for land use fees and mining royalties required for mining operations have adversely affected the mining sector and reduced the attractiveness of mining investments. Therefore, assessing the economic feasibility of mining requires an integrated approach that considers the total financial burden imposed on mining companies rather than evaluating individual fees separately. To address this issue, data on various land use fees, operating costs, and other relevant parameters were collected from mining companies through the SurveyMonkey program. This analysis was motivated by the limited publicly available information on the actual magnitude of land use costs incurred by mining companies and the possibility that mining and environmental authorities may assess individual fees separately without considering their cumulative financial burden. Accordingly, this study evaluates land use fees and mining royalties in Turkey both individually and collectively, calculating their values per tonne of mineral production, per hectare of land, and on an annual basis. The ratios of these costs to mining operating costs were subsequently determined. The results indicate that the average land use cost is €1.65 ton⁻¹ year⁻¹ of mineral production and €3440.7 ha⁻¹ year⁻¹ of land used, while the combined land use fees included in the analysis account for 29.15% of total operating costs. Forest fees constitute the largest individual component, accounting for 8.39% of operating costs. In particular, revising the calculation methodology for forest fees and reducing the resulting financial burden could improve the economic feasibility and competitiveness of mining operations in Turkey.
abstract_zh: 在土耳其，矿业公司需向林业管理部门缴纳多种类型的林地使用费，同时还需向相关矿业及环保主管部门支付环境合规费、国家权益金及经营许可证费用。相比之下，恢复治理和废弃物管理成本并非由公共机构直接计算并征收的费用，而是矿业公司为履行监管义务而产生的支出。近年来，土耳其有关矿业用地使用费及采矿权益金计算方法的立法变动，对采矿业造成了不利影响，降低了矿业投资的吸引力。因此，评估采矿经济可行性需要采用综合方法，考虑矿业公司承担的总体财务负担，而非单独评估各项费用。为解决这一问题，通过SurveyMonkey程序向矿业公司收集了各类用地使用费、运营成本及其他相关参数的数据。此项分析的动因在于，关于矿业公司实际承担的用地成本规模，公开信息有限，且矿业与环保主管部门可能单独评估各项费用，而未考虑其累积财务负担。据此，本研究分别从单项和整体角度评估土耳其的用地使用费及采矿权益金，计算其每吨矿产产量、每公顷用地及年度基础上的数值，并进一步确定这些成本占矿业运营成本的比例。结果表明，平均用地成本为每吨矿产产量每年1.65欧元，每公顷用地每年3440.7欧元，而纳入分析的各项用地使用费合计占运营总成本的29.15%。林地使用费是最大的单项组成部分，占运营成本的8.39%。特别是，修订林地使用费的计算方法并降低由此产生的财务负担，有望提升土耳其矿业运营的经济可行性和竞争力。

abstract: This paper studies robust mechanism design in bilateral trade under limited information. I introduce a new class of mechanisms in which the buyer and seller submit a bid and an ask, and trade occurs when the bid–ask difference exceeds a random spread drawn from a publicly known distribution. Conditional on trade, the asset is sold at the midpoint price, and each trader pays the same commission, which depends on the bid–ask difference through a function determined by the random spread distribution. I show that these mechanisms, termed generalized double auctions, are strategy-proof and include both welfare-guarantee-maximizing and profit-guarantee-maximizing mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了信息有限条件下双边贸易中的稳健机制设计。我引入了一类新型机制，其中买方和卖方分别提交出价与要价，当买卖价差超过一个由公开已知分布随机抽取的价差时，交易发生。在交易条件下，资产以中间价出售，每位交易者支付相同的佣金，该佣金通过由随机价差分布决定的函数依赖于买卖价差。我证明，这些被称为广义双重拍卖的机制是策略-proof的，并包含了最大化福利保障和最大化利润保障的机制。

abstract: This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了由企业层面违约风险引发的信贷摩擦对总体经济表现的影响。我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观至宏观模型，表明感知违约风险是信贷摩擦的充分统计量。利用英国行政数据（2004-2019年）与标普风险度量相匹配，反事实估计显示，缓解摩擦可使产出提高25%，工资提高23%。忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而固定资本错配方法则低估这些收益。大部分收益源于总体资本积累。信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平，重塑了企业规模动态，加剧了企业间的错配，并随时间推移抑制了生产率增长。

abstract: This paper examines the economic origins and consequences of anti-missionary violence during the late Qing China (1860-1911). Using newly digitized data, we find that conflicts were attenuated by economic complementarities - such as access to Treaty Ports and public goods - rather than triggered by religious competition with Confucian elites. On the consequences part, we document negative economic spillovers of anti-missionary conflicts, through reduced foreign and domestic investments in modern firms and banks. These negative outcomes were reinforced by Western media coverage and persist today through lower FDI flows and increased autarkic attitudes among residents.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了晚清时期（1860-1911年）反传教士暴力的经济根源及其后果。利用新近数字化的数据，我们发现冲突因经济互补性——如通商口岸的准入及公共品的提供——而得到缓和，而非由与儒家精英的宗教竞争所触发。就后果而言，我们记录了反传教士冲突通过减少外资及国内对现代企业和银行的投入，产生了负面的经济溢出效应。这些负面结果因西方媒体的报道而加剧，并持续至今，表现为较低的外商直接投资流入及居民中增强的自给自足倾向。

abstract: Is war good for economic development? Several macrohistorical theories suggest “yes”, yet the supporting evidence relies on war being shocked exogenously. We first examine the raw data from Europe, showing a negative relationship between war and production in both ancient and modern periods. We then create a model to investigate what typical statistical analyses show on data generated with standard conflict mechanisms. We show that typical statistical analyses suggest war positively affects growth in our model economy when it is in fact harmful. We caution against “mostly harmless” regressions that suggest European prosperity comes from its harmful history rather than its peaceful present.
abstract_zh: 战争是否有利于经济发展？若干宏观历史理论倾向于肯定回答，然而其支持证据依赖于战争作为外生冲击的假设。我们首先审视欧洲的原始数据，显示无论在古代还是现代，战争与生产之间均呈负相关关系。随后，我们构建一个模型，探究在标准冲突机制生成的数据上，典型统计分析会呈现何种结果。我们证明，在我们的模型经济中，当战争实际上有害时，典型统计分析却表明战争对增长有积极影响。我们警示，那些看似“基本无害”的回归分析，若暗示欧洲的繁荣源自其苦难历史而非和平现状，则需谨慎对待。

abstract: 健全与国际规则相衔接的知识产权保护机制是推进高水平制度型开放的重要内容。本文立足于我国《专利法》向TRIPS的三次协调这一规制开放的客观事实,使用广义双重差分模型考察知识产权规制开放对中国国际专利申请的影响。研究发现：《专利法》TRIPS协调通过同族专利挤出、专利意识强化及自主创新激励三条路径影响中国国际专利申请;1992年《专利法》TRIPS协调以同族专利挤出效应为主,整体阻碍国际专利申请,而2000和2008年《专利法》TRIPS协调,专利意识强化与自主创新激励效应显著,整体促进国际专利申请。在技术深度密集、贸易活跃度高、高技术价值以及高联合创新水平的行业和低专利集中度的目的地中,以上政策效果更为突出。此外,仅第三次协调对国际专利释放“提质”效应,但未实现“增效”目标。本文系统评估了我国《专利法》TRIPS协调的政策成效,为深入推进我国高水平制度型开放与实施创新驱动发展战略提供了政策启示。

abstract: We demonstrate how selection in competitive markets can impede longrun reputational incentives. In our model, competent firms can exert costly effort to improve expected product quality, but inept firms cannot. With low entry barriers, we show competent firms cannot persistently exert effort, despite bounded memory. Such effort would cause consumers to select firms based on reputations for competence, eventually selecting a monopolist with arbitrarily high reputation, which has no incentive for effort. More generally, reputation-based selection rules out long-run effort, which then undermines the basis for such selection. Intermediate entry barriers provide stronger reputational incentives than low or high barriers.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了竞争市场中的选择机制如何阻碍长期声誉激励。在我们的模型中，有能力的企业可以通过付出高昂努力来提升预期产品质量，而无能的企业则无法做到。在低进入壁垒条件下，我们发现即使存在有限记忆，有能力的企业也无法持续付出努力。这种努力会导致消费者基于企业能力声誉进行选择，最终筛选出具有任意高声誉的垄断者，而该垄断者缺乏付出努力的动机。更一般地，基于声誉的选择机制排除了长期努力的可能性，而这反过来又削弱了此类选择机制的基础。中等程度的进入壁垒比低壁垒或高壁垒能提供更强的声誉激励。

abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000–2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.

official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 通常被引用来表明通胀预期已更好锚定的实证证据包括：预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性随时间推移而下降，尤其是在采用通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与基于经验的学习模型一致——在该模型中，个体仅依据其一生经历的实际通胀历史进行学习，而无需将预期锚定于公布的官方通胀目标。在该模型下，新冠疫情前数十年间低短期通胀持续性的长期经历，使得长期预期对通胀意外冲击不敏感，这与实证锚定检验中观察到的模式相吻合。数据还验证了基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测：自20世纪80年代以来，年轻群体对通胀意外冲击敏感性的下降幅度最大。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升期间保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，若个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外冲击的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能低于普遍认知。

authors: Amin, Mohammad, Rodriguez Cuniolo, Eugenia Aurora
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of informal competition—defined as competition faced by formal firms from informal enterprises—on the firm-provided worker training among formal manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises. Using a representative dataset of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms in 23 Sub-Saharan African countries, a sizable negative impact is found. A one-standard-deviation increase in informal competition reduces the probability that a firm offers training to its workers by 8.7 to 12.9 percentage points, relative to the sample mean of firms that offer training of approximately 25 percent. Comparable declines are observed in the share of workers receiving training. To address potential endogeneity, the paper employs several complementary strategies. First, an instrumental-variables strategy leverages variation in the number of children aged 0–4 and 5–9 years per working-age woman to generate exogenous shifts in informal competition. Second, heterogeneity is examined through tests derived from the “legalist” view of informality, which predicts bigger adverse effects of informal competition in environments characterized by a weaker rule of law and more stringent business regulations. Third, information about firms in other world regions is used to construct out-of-sample predictions of informal competition at the sector level. The findings sugge st that informal competition is a substantial constraint on the training investments of formal firms, underscoring the need for policy responses that mitigate its adverse consequences.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业提供员工培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量策略，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。

title_zh: 中央银行透明度能否抑制外汇脆弱性？

source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行透明度（CBT）对外汇市场脆弱性（以汇率市场压力（EMP）衡量）的影响。通过对32个国家的面板自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析，结果表明，更高的中央银行透明度显著降低了汇率市场压力。在控制美国货币政策不确定性、经济政策不确定性和金融发展水平后，该结论依然稳健。然而，未发现中央银行透明度在不确定性加剧时期更为有效的证据。进一步分析表明，汇率灵活性和金融一体化增强了中央银行透明度对新兴市场汇率市场压力的缓解效应，但在发达市场中并不显著。

title: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?
title_zh: 流动性将存在！但传导会实现吗？
title_primary: 流动性将存在！但传导会实现吗？
title_secondary: There Will Be Liquidity! But Will There Be Transmission?
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of voluntary and involuntary excess liquidity on monetary policy effectiveness and inflation in Kazakhstan. Consistent with first-principles predictions, we find that voluntary liquidity held for precautionary motives is (i) negatively related to the opportunity cost of holding liquid assets and to the level of mandatory reserve requirements; (ii) positively related to average liquidity outflows, proxied by transactional demand for cash; and (iii) ambiguously affected by the magnitude and volatility of the business cycle. We further show that higher voluntary liquidity weakens monetary policy transmission and increases exchange rate pass-through to inflation. In contrast, involuntary liquidity hampers monetary policy effectiveness no matter its level and it increases average inflation primarily through its influence on the formation of inflation expectations. Overall, the results suggest that reforms aimed at reducing both forms of liquidity would enhance monetary policy effectiveness and, ceteris paribus, reduce inflation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了哈萨克斯坦自愿性与非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策有效性和通货膨胀的影响。与基本原理预测一致，我们发现：出于预防性动机持有的自愿性流动性（i）与持有流动性资产的机会成本及法定准备金要求水平呈负相关；（ii）与以现金交易需求为代理变量的平均流动性流出呈正相关；（iii）受经济周期幅度和波动性的影响具有模糊性。我们进一步证明，较高的自愿性流动性会削弱货币政策传导机制，并增强汇率传递对通货膨胀的影响。相比之下，无论非自愿性流动性水平高低，其均会阻碍货币政策有效性，并主要通过影响通胀预期形成机制推高平均通胀水平。总体而言，研究结果表明，旨在减少两种形式流动性的改革将提升货币政策有效性，并在其他条件不变的情况下降低通货膨胀。

authors: Mr. Serkan Arslanalp & Oliver Exton & Chang Gao & Mario Saraiva & Ms. Parisa Kamali & Alessandra Sozzi & Jasper Verschuur
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops high frequency trade estimates at the country level by applying nowcasting methodologies to satellite-based big data on vessel movements sourced from IMF PortWatch. The approach provides a timely estimate of monthly trade at the country level that can be produced and released within 7 working days. The paper validates the nowcasting trade estimates against official data for an initial wave of countries representing advanced economies, emerging markets and small island developing states: Brazil, Jamaica, Japan, Samoa, and the United States. The nowcasting methodology produces trade estimates that perform well compared to the official statistics, with the best fit for advanced economies and large emerging markets. The paper identifies key complementary information to improve the presented nowcasting methodology to develop country trade estimates. The paper also considers an application to estimates of U.S. imports during a period of elevated trade tensions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将即时预测方法应用于国际货币基金组织港口观察（IMF PortWatch）提供的基于卫星的船舶移动大数据，开发了国家层面的高频贸易估算。该方法可在7个工作日内生成并发布国家层面的月度贸易及时估算。本文以首批涵盖发达经济体、新兴市场和小岛屿发展中国家的国家（巴西、牙买加、日本、萨摩亚和美国）为对象，将即时预测贸易估算与官方数据进行验证。结果表明，该即时预测方法生成的贸易估算与官方统计数据拟合良好，其中对发达经济体和大型新兴市场的拟合效果最佳。本文识别了改进现有即时预测方法以完善国家贸易估算的关键补充信息，并进一步探讨了该方法在贸易紧张局势加剧时期对美国进口估算的应用。

title: Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
title_zh: 风中之尘：大盐湖干涸的健康代价
title_primary: 风中之尘：大盐湖干涸的健康代价
title_secondary: Dust in the Wind: The Health Costs of Great Salt Lake Desiccation
authors: Lena Harris, Eric C. Edwards, Danae Hernandez-Cortes
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km² of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.
abstract_zh: 自然来源的空气污染通常受到的监管较少，但仍可能由人类活动引发。理解政策的作用需要量化该来源的污染贡献，但目前尚无标准方法论。本文以美国犹他州大盐湖萎缩为背景，对高度可侵蚀且不断扩大的裸露湖床区域的空气质量影响进行建模。利用空气污染文献中四种常见的识别策略及三种替代性污染测量技术，我们发现在非冬季月份，湖泊萎缩导致显著的污染增加，且证据一致。估计值对测量技术相对不敏感，但随识别策略不同而变化。每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年成本介于8100万至1.75亿美元之间。按总裸露湖床面积推算，与干涸相关的年度健康成本估计值介于11亿至23亿美元之间。鉴于流域内人类用水与裸露湖床之间的直接关系，这些结果为旨在减少消耗性用水的政策提供了成本效益证据。

title: Herding in the foreign exchange market
title_zh: 外汇市场中的羊群效应
title_primary: 外汇市场中的羊群效应
title_secondary: Herding in the foreign exchange market
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using a recent and comprehensive data set covering nine of the most actively traded currencies on a monthly basis from 1995 to 2024, this paper explores the presence and potential drivers of herding behaviour in foreign exchange rate forecasts. The dataset features an average of 40–50 forecasters per currency, representing a broader range of currencies, a longer time frame, and a larger cross section of forecasters than is commonly found in the FX herding literature. Our results provide mixed evidence on herding, where the balance tends towards anti-herding conclusions.While some revision-based tests suggest herding when current consensus forecasts are used, this evidence weakens considerably when lagged information is employed. In contrast, forecast-error based tests, Bernhardt et al. statistics, and over-reaction regressions more often point to anti-herding, particularly at longer horizons. Overall, we interpret the findings as suggesting thatdifferences among forecasters are largely attributable to heterogeneous views, noise, or idiosyncratic error rather than systematic convergence toward the consensus. When alternative explanations for expectation formation or revisions are considered, the main findings remain unchanged across a wide range of measures, including different types of uncertainty and FX predictors such as the forward premium, the real exchange rate, and the depreciation rate. JEL Classification: C10, C22, F31, F47, G17
abstract_zh: 本文利用1995年至2024年涵盖九种最活跃交易货币的月度高频综合数据集，探究外汇汇率预测中羊群行为的存在性及其潜在驱动因素。该数据集平均每种货币包含40-50位预测者，相较于外汇羊群行为研究文献，其覆盖货币范围更广、时间跨度更长、预测者截面规模更大。研究结果为羊群行为提供了混合证据，整体结论更倾向于反羊群行为。当采用当前共识预测时，部分基于修正的检验显示存在羊群行为，但使用滞后信息后该证据显著减弱。相比之下，基于预测误差的检验、Bernhardt等人统计量及过度反应回归更常指向反羊群行为，尤其在较长预测期限中。总体而言，我们认为预测者间的差异主要源于异质性观点、噪声或特质性误差，而非系统性趋同于共识。在考虑预期形成或修正的替代性解释后，主要结论在涵盖不同类型不确定性及远期升水、实际汇率、贬值率等外汇预测因子的广泛指标体系中保持稳健。JEL分类号：C10, C22, F31, F47, G17

official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study analyses the records in the Cairo geniza , the distribution of Chinese ceramics, the reports of travellers (this is the best‐known, but least important, dataset), and the discussions of the Portuguese regarding how best to exploit pepper in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. This is then set against what evidence there is from Kerala itself. It emerges that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance. The Kerala economy was based on rice, and it remained so. The article therefore contributes to the growing historiography which stresses internal regional economies rather than external trading as the best guide for understanding pre‐modern development, as opposed to world‐systems theories, but it also aims to show in detail why it was that the pepper trade had relatively little impact on its producer region. Kerala was the only source of pepper for the whole Eurasian world until the late Middle Ages. This article argues that, despite the importance of pepper to the trading systems of the medieval period, the impact of that trade on Kerala was of relatively small importance, and discusses why.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了开罗藏经库文献、中国陶瓷分布、旅行者报告（这是最知名但重要性最低的数据集），以及16至17世纪早期葡萄牙人关于如何最佳利用胡椒的讨论。随后将这些证据与喀拉拉邦本地的史料进行对照。研究发现，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中具有重要地位，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对较小。喀拉拉邦的经济以稻米为基础，且始终如此。因此，本文为强调以区域内部经济而非外部贸易作为理解前现代发展最佳路径的史学新范式提供了佐证——这与世界体系理论形成对比；同时旨在详细阐释为何胡椒贸易对其产地影响甚微。喀拉拉邦直至中世纪末期仍是整个欧亚大陆唯一的胡椒产地。本文论证指出，尽管胡椒在中世纪贸易体系中举足轻重，但该贸易对喀拉拉邦的影响相对有限，并探讨了其成因。

abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic, while work from home (WFH) has risen fourfold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0 percent for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68–85 percent of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggest that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions. title: Is Technological Heterogeneity the Key to Sustainable Coffee Production Efficiency?: A Latent Class Frontier Analysis in the Traditional Coffee Region of Colombia

authors: Orlando Rodríguez, Maria Vrachioli, Johannes Sauer
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Coffee producers deal with uncertainty due to high volatility in coffee prices. To navigate these challenges, producers must balance the tradeoff between higher yield and better quality utilising heterogeneous technologies, such as intensive production methods and environmental management practices. The aim of this study is to identify the extent to which heterogeneous technologies, particularly those focused on sustainable management, can influence the technical efficiency of Colombian coffee farms. Using the Latent Class Stochastic Frontier Model (LCSFM), we studied the unobserved differences in technologies among 387 Colombian coffee farms in the Andes. Our findings show that farms adhering to sustainable standards achieved an efficiency rate of 95.68%, compared to 74.93% for farms heavily reliant on chemical pesticides. These results underscore the efficiency benefits of sustainable practices and provide targeted recommendations to improve productivity among different groups of coffee growers. This research contributes to the broader understanding of how adopting sustainable technologies can enhance efficiency in coffee production, offering key insights for policymakers and practitioners aiming to stabilise and develop the sector.
abstract_zh: 摘要 咖啡生产者因咖啡价格的高度波动而面临不确定性。为应对这些挑战，生产者必须利用异质性技术，如集约化生产方法和环境管理实践，在高产量与高品质之间权衡取舍。本研究旨在确定异质性技术，尤其是侧重于可持续管理的技术，能在多大程度上影响哥伦比亚咖啡农场的技术效率。采用潜在类别随机前沿模型（LCSFM），我们研究了安第斯山脉地区387个哥伦比亚咖啡农场在技术上的未观测差异。研究结果显示，遵循可持续标准的农场实现了95.68%的效率，而严重依赖化学农药的农场效率为74.93%。这些结果凸显了可持续实践的效率优势，并为提升不同咖啡种植者群体的生产力提供了有针对性的建议。本研究有助于更广泛地理解采用可持续技术如何提升咖啡生产效率，为旨在稳定和发展该行业的政策制定者及从业者提供了关键见解。

abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. abstract: The standard model of choice in economics is the maximization of a complete and transitive preference relation over a fixed set of alternatives. While completeness of preferences is usually regarded as a strong assumption, weakening it requires care to ensure that the resulting model still has enough structure to yield interesting results. This paper takes a step in this direction by studying the class of "connected preferences", that is, preferences that may fail to be complete but have connected maximal domains of comparability. We offer four new results. Theorem 1 identifies a basic necessary condition for a continuous preference to be connected in the sense above, while Theorem 2 provides sufficient conditions. Building on the latter, Theorem 3 characterizes the maximal domains of comparability. Finally, Theorem 4 presents conditions that ensure that maximal domains are arc-connected.
